Shared ETag primitives (single source of truth for hash/match semantics). Consumed by the etag middleware and the response layer (RFC 7232).Computes the deterministic FNV-1a 64-bit hash of the content.Returns the uppercase token form of the HTTP method.Returns true if the method appears in the comma-separated allow list, defaulting to GET and HEAD when empty.Removes the weak validator prefix and surrounding whitespace from an ETag.Compares two ETags with weak comparison, ignoring the weak prefix and whitespace.Returns true if the If-None-Match header value matches the ETag using weak comparison.

Check If-None-Match against an ETag using weak comparison (RFC 7232 §3.2). Do NOT use for If-Match validation, which requires strong comparison.

Weak ETag comparison (RFC 7232 §2.3): ignores W//w/ prefix and whitespace. Known minor cost: stripWeakPrefix allocates per side; acceptable because this only runs during conditional-request handling on small headers.
